        "contents": "import { createServerClient } from \"@supabase/ssr\";\nimport {\n  createErrorUrl,\n  redirectWithCookies,\n  hasEmailIdentity,\n} from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Handles OAuth callback from Google\n * Exchanges the code for a session and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);\n  const code = searchParams.get(\"code\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n  if (!code) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"No code provided\"));\n  }\n\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt; {\n            request.cookies.set(name, value);\n          });\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n  if (error) {\n    return redirectWithCookies(createErrorUrl(request, error.message), supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has email identity linked\n  // If not, redirect to verify-email page\n  // Use the same supabase client to ensure we have the just-exchanged session\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n\n  // Validate the next parameter to prevent open redirects\n  const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, origin);\n\n  if (hasEmail) {\n    // User has email identity, redirect to next or default page\n    const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Creates a success redirect URL\n * @param request - The NextRequest object\n * @param next - Optional next parameter to redirect to after success\n * @returns URL object for redirect\n */\nexport function createSuccessUrl(request: NextRequest, next?: string | null): URL {\n  const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n\n  if (next) {\n    // Validate next parameter to prevent open redirects\n    const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, request.nextUrl.origin);\n    if (validatedNext) {\n      // Parse the redirect URL to handle query parameters and hash properly\n      const redirectUrl = new URL(validatedNext, request.nextUrl.origin);\n      url.pathname = redirectUrl.pathname;\n      url.search = redirectUrl.search;\n      url.hash = redirectUrl.hash;\n      return url;\n    }\n  }\n\n  url.pathname = DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n  url.search = \"\"; // Clear any existing search params\n  url.hash = \"\"; // Clear any existing hash\n  return url;\n}\n\n/**\n * Creates a redirect response with cookies copied from supabaseResponse\n * Preserves all cookie options (httpOnly, secure, sameSite, etc.)\n */",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  if (!authUser) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // If no email identity, redirect to verify email page\n  // Treat errors as \"no identity\" to preserve graceful redirect behavior\n  const emailIdentityCheck = await safeCheck(\n    () =&gt; hasEmailIdentity(supabase),\n    \"hasEmailIdentity\",\n  );\n  if (!emailIdentityCheck.ok) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-email\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check for linked profile if user is authenticated and not on public routes\n  // Skip this check for verify-email and pending-approval routes\n  // Treat errors as \"no profile\" to preserve graceful redirect behavior\n  const linkedProfileCheck = await safeCheck(\n    () =&gt; hasLinkedProfile(supabase),\n    \"hasLinkedProfile\",\n  );\n  if (!linkedProfileCheck.ok) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/pending-approval\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Strip all query parameters (e.g., from email verification or QR code)\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Strip hash as well\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // For protected routes (dashboard, etc.), we need to check verification\n  // This is done on the page level for better UX with proper error messages\n\n  return supabaseResponse;\n}",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\n\n/**\n * Google OAuth login button component\n * Handles both sign-in and sign-up flows seamlessly\n */\nexport function GoogleLoginButton({ next }: { next?: string }) {\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleGoogleLogin = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    const supabase = createClient();\n\n    try {\n      const callbackUrl = new URL(&#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/callback&#96;);\n      if (next) {\n        // Properly encode the next parameter - it may contain query parameters itself\n        // Use encodeURIComponent to ensure it's properly encoded\n        callbackUrl.searchParams.set(\"next\", next);\n      }\n\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n        provider: \"google\",\n        options: {\n          redirectTo: callbackUrl.toString(),\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (error) {\n        console.error(\"Google OAuth error:\", error);\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n      // Note: User will be redirected to Google, so we don't reset loading state here\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Unexpected error:\", error);\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return\n}",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  // If the env vars are not set, skip proxy check. You can remove this\n  // once you setup the project.\n\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n            request.cookies.set(name, value)\n          );\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options)\n          );\n        },\n      },\n    }\n  );\n\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n  const user = data?.claims;\n\n  const pathname = request.nextUrl.pathname;\n  // Include full path with query parameters and hash for next parameter\n  const fullPath = pathname + request.nextUrl.search + request.nextUrl.hash;\n\n  // Allow public routes without authentication\n  if (isPublicRoute(pathname))\n}",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\nconst handleSendOTP = async \n\n      savePersistedState({ step: \"otp\", email: email.trim() });\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Verifies the OTP code and links email identity to user\n   * Uses type 'email_change' since we're updating the user's email via updateUser()\n   * With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n   * to the existing authenticated user account\n   */\n  const verifyOTP = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    const trimmedOtp = otpCode.trim();\n\n    // Track the OTP being submitted to prevent re-submission\n    setLastSubmittedOtp(trimmedOtp);\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Verify OTP code for email change/linking\n      // Use type 'email_change' because we used updateUser() to initiate the flow\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // to the current authenticated user instead of creating a new user\n      const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n        email: email.trim(),\n        token: trimmedOtp,\n        type: \"email_change\",\n      });\n\n      if (verifyError) {\n        setError(verifyError.message || \"Invalid OTP code\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n        // The code remains in the input so user can see what they entered\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Refresh session to ensure identities are updated\n      await supabase.auth.refreshSession();\n\n      // Clear persisted state on success\n      clearPersistedState();\n\n      // Success - redirect to next parameter or default page\n      // Validate next parameter to prevent open redirects\n      const validatedNext = next ? validateRedirectUrl(next, window.location.origin) : null;\n      const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n      router.push(redirectTo);\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n      // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n    }\n  }, [email, otpCode, next, supabase, router]);\n\n  /**\n   * Handles form submission for OTP verification\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { createServerClient } from \"@supabase/ssr\";\nimport {\n  createErrorUrl,\n  createSuccessUrl,\n  redirectWithCookies,\n} from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * Handles email change confirmation callback using PKCE flow with token_hash\n * Verifies the OTP token and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const typeParam = searchParams.get(\"type\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n  const type: EmailOtpType | null =\n    typeParam === \"email_change\" ? (\"email_change\" as EmailOtpType) : null;\n\n  if (!type) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"Invalid type\"));\n  }\n  if (!token_hash) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"Invalid token hash\"));\n  }\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt; {\n            request.cookies.set(name, value);\n          });\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n    type,\n    token_hash,\n  });\n  if (error) {\n    return redirectWithCookies(createErrorUrl(request, error.message), supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  return redirectWithCookies(createSuccessUrl(request, next), supabaseResponse);\n}",

        "contents": "   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,",

        "contents": "export function VerifyForm() {\n\n\n  const handleVerifyCode = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch(\"/api/verify/check-code\", {\n        method: \"POST\",\n        headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\n        body: JSON.stringify({ school_email: schoolEmail, code }),\n      });\n\n      const data = await response.json();\n\n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error(data.error || \"Ověření se nezdařilo\");\n      }\n\n      // Refresh auth state and redirect to dashboard\n      const supabase = createClient();\n      await supabase.auth.refreshSession();\n      router.push(\"/\");\n    } catch (error: unknown) {\n      setError(\n        error instanceof Error ? error.message : \"Ověření se nezdařilo\"\n      );\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleResendCode = async () =&gt; {\n    if (cooldown &gt; 0) return;\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch(\"/api/verify/send-code\", {\n        method: \"POST\",\n        headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\n        body: JSON.stringify({ school_email: schoolEmail }),\n      });\n\n      const data = await response.json();\n\n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error(data.error || \"Odeslání kódu se nezdařilo\");\n      }\n\n      startCooldown();\n    } catch (error: unknown) {\n      setError(\n        error instanceof Error ? error.message : \"Odeslání kódu se nezdařilo\"\n      );\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-md space-y-6\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\nconst handleSendOTP = async \n\n      if (confirmUrl.search === \"\") {\n        // No query parameters, add ? for token_hash\n        redirectUrl += \"?\";\n      } else {\n        // Has query parameters, ensure it ends with &amp; for token_hash\n        if (!redirectUrl.endsWith(\"&amp;\")) {\n          redirectUrl += \"&amp;\";\n        }\n      }\n\n      const { data: updateData, error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser(\n        {\n          email: email.trim(),\n        },\n        {\n          emailRedirectTo: redirectUrl,\n        },\n      );\n\n      if (updateError) {\n        // If email already exists, that's actually fine - it means it might already be linked\n        // or we need to handle it differently\n        if (updateError.message?.includes(\"already registered\")) {\n          setError(\"This email is already registered. Please use a different email or sign in with that email.\");\n        } else {\n          setError(updateError.message || \"Failed to send OTP code\");\n        }\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Update suggested_work_email in public.users table\n      // This enables cross-device synchronization and persistence\n      // The trigger will automatically set last_otp_sent_at\n      const { data: userData, error: getUserError } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n      if (getUserError || !userData?.user?.id) {\n        // Log error but don't block the flow - OTP was sent successfully\n        console.error(\"Failed to get user for suggested_work_email update:\", getUserError || \"User ID is undefined\");\n      } else {\n        const { error: userUpdateError } = await supabase\n          .from(\"users\")\n          .update({ suggested_work_email: email.trim() })\n          .eq(\"auth_user_id\", userData.user.id);\n\n        if (userUpdateError) {\n          // Log error but don't block the flow - OTP was sent successfully\n          console.error(\"Failed to update suggested_work_email:\", userUpdateError);\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Move to OTP verification step\n      setStep(\"otp\");\n      savePersistedState({ step: \"otp\", email: email.trim() });\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    } catch (err)\n;\n}",

        "contents": "import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from \"next/server\";\n\nconst MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;\n\nexport async function POST(request: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { school_email, code } = await request.json();\n\n    // Validate inputs\n    if (!school_email || !code) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Chybí e-mail nebo kód\" },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Get current user\n    const {\n      data: { user },\n    } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n    if (!user) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Neautorizováno\" },\n        { status: 401 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Find the latest unused, non-expired code for this user and email\n    const { data: verificationCode, error: codeError } = await supabase\n      .from(\"verification_codes\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"user_id\", user.id)\n      .eq(\"school_email\", school_email.toLowerCase())\n      .eq(\"used\", false)\n      .gt(\"expires_at\", new Date().toISOString())\n      .order(\"created_at\", { ascending: false })\n      .limit(1)\n      .single();\n\n    if (codeError || !verificationCode) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Kód vypršel nebo neexistuje. Požádejte o nový.\" },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Check attempts\n    if (verificationCode.attempts &gt;= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {\n      // Mark code as used (exhausted)\n      await supabase\n        .from(\"verification_codes\")\n        .update({ used: true })\n        .eq(\"id\", verificationCode.id);\n\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Příliš mnoho pokusů. Požádejte o nový kód.\" },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Check if code matches\n    if (verificationCode.code !== code)\n}",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Handles form submission for OTP verification\n   */\n  const handleVerifyOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    await verifyOTP();\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Loads persisted state from sessionStorage after component mounts (client-side only)\n   * This prevents hydration mismatches between server and client\n   */\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const persisted = loadPersistedState();\n\n    // Validate persisted state - if on OTP step but no email, reset to email step\n    if (persisted.step === \"otp\" &amp;&amp; (!persisted.email || !persisted.email.includes(\"@\"))) {\n      setStep(\"email\");\n      setEmail(\"\");\n      clearPersistedState();\n      setIsHydrated(true);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Restore persisted state if valid\n    if (persisted.email &amp;&amp; persisted.email.includes(\"@\")) {\n      setEmail(persisted.email);\n    }\n    if (persisted.step === \"email\" || persisted.step === \"otp\") {\n      setStep(persisted.step);\n    }\n\n    setIsHydrated(true);\n  }, []);\n\n  /**\n   * Persists email changes to sessionStorage\n   * Only saves when we have a valid email address and after hydration\n   */\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // Don't persist until after hydration to avoid hydration mismatches\n    if (!isHydrated) return;\n\n    if (email &amp;&amp; email.includes(\"@\")) {\n      savePersistedState({ step, email });\n    } else if (step === \"otp\" &amp;&amp; !email) {\n      // If on OTP step but no email, clear invalid state\n      clearPersistedState();\n    }\n  }, [email, step, isHydrated]);\n\n  /**\n   * Auto-submits the form when OTP code reaches the expected length\n   * This handles paste events and manual entry\n   * Prevents re-submission of the same OTP code after a failed verification\n   */\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const trimmedOtp = otpCode.trim();\n    const isOtpComplete = trimmedOtp.length === OTP_LENGTH;\n    const isNewOtp = trimmedOtp !== lastSubmittedOtp;\n\n    if (step === \"otp\" &amp;&amp; isOtpComplete &amp;&amp; !isLoading &amp;&amp; isNewOtp) {\n      verifyOTP();\n    }\n  }, [otpCode, step, isLoading, lastSubmittedOtp, verifyOTP]);\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Card&gt;\n      &lt;CardHeader&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * GET /r/[code]\n * Short URL redirect for QR codes\n * - If user is logged in -&gt; reservations/[code]/qr\n * - If not logged in -&gt; /rezervace/[code]\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest, { params }: RouteParams) {\n  const { code } = await params;\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Check if user is logged in\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (user) {\n    // Logged in -&gt; redirect to quick status page\n    const url = new URL(&#96;/reservations/${code}/quick&#96;, request.url);\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  } else {\n    // Not logged in -&gt; redirect to public page\n    const url = new URL(&#96;/rezervace/${code}&#96;, request.url);\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Quick status page for room scans\n * Shows instant room availability status with fullscreen colored design\n */\nexport default async function QuickStatusPage({ params }: QuickPageProps) {\n  const { code } = await params;\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Fetch room by code\n  const { data: room, error: roomError } = await supabase\n    .from(\"rooms\")\n    .select(\"*\")\n    .eq(\"code\", code.toLowerCase())\n    .single();\n\n  if (roomError || !room) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  const now = new Date();\n  const nowIso = now.toISOString();\n\n  // Fetch current reservation\n  const { data: currentReservation } = await supabase\n    .from(\"reservations\")\n    .select(&#96;\n      *,\n      user:profiles(id, full_name),\n      team:teams(id, name)\n    &#96;)\n    .eq(\"room_id\", room.id)\n    .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n    .lte(\"start_time\", nowIso)\n    .gt(\"end_time\", nowIso)\n    .single();\n\n  // Fetch open issues\n  const { data: issues } = await supabase\n    .from(\"room_issues\")\n    .select(\"*\")\n    .eq(\"room_id\", room.id)\n    .eq(\"status\", \"open\");\n\n  const roomIssues = (issues || []) as RoomIssue[];\n  const isLocked = roomIssues.some((i) =&gt; i.issue_type === \"locked\");\n  const otherIssues = roomIssues\n    .filter((i) =&gt; i.issue_type !== \"locked\")\n    .map((i) =&gt; {\n      const labels: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n        mess: \"Nepořádek\",\n        technical: \"Technický problém\",\n        other: \"Jiné\",\n      };\n      return labels[i.issue_type] || i.issue_type;\n    });\n\n  // Determine status\n  let status: 'free' | 'occupied' | 'locked' = 'free';\n  if (isLocked) {\n    status = 'locked';\n  } else if (currentReservation) {\n    status = 'occupied';\n  }\n\n  // Build response data\n  const quickStatusData = {\n    room: {\n      id: room.id,\n      code: room.code,\n      name: room.name,\n      description: room.description,\n    },\n    status,\n    issues: {\n      isLocked,\n      otherIssues,\n    },\n  };\n\n  // Add current reservation details if occupied\n  let currentReservationData = undefined;\n  let alternativeRooms = undefined;\n\n  if (currentReservation) {\n    const endTime = new Date(currentReservation.end_time);\n}",

        "contents": "export default async function RoomDetailPage({ params }: RoomDetailPageProps) {\n\n\n  const [reservationsResult, issuesResult, alternativeRoomsResult, breaksResult] = await Promise.all([\n    // Reservations for this room (past 7 days + next 14 days for calendar navigation)\n    supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"room_id\", room.id)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .gte(\"start_time\", oneWeekAgo.toISOString())\n      .lte(\"start_time\", twoWeeksLater.toISOString())\n      .order(\"start_time\"),\n\n    // Open issues for this room\n    supabase\n      .from(\"room_issues\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"room_id\", room.id)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"open\")\n      .order(\"created_at\", { ascending: false }),\n\n    // Alternative rooms for suggestions\n    supabase\n      .from(\"rooms\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .neq(\"id\", room.id)\n      .order(\"code\"),\n\n    // Schedule breaks for the date range (past 7 + future 14 days)\n    supabase\n      .from(\"schedule_breaks\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .lte(\"start_date\", twoWeeksLaterStr)\n      .gte(\"end_date\", oneWeekAgoStr)\n      .order(\"start_date\"),\n  ]);\n\n  const reservations = (reservationsResult.data || []) as Reservation[];\n  const issues = (issuesResult.data || []) as RoomIssue[];\n  const allAlternativeRooms = (alternativeRoomsResult.data || []) as Room[];\n  const scheduleBreaks = (breaksResult.data || []) as ScheduleBreak[];\n\n  // Sort alternative rooms based on current room type\n}",

        "contents": "export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  if (hasEmail) {\n    // User has email identity, redirect to next or default page\n    const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n\n    // Parse the redirect URL to handle query parameters properly\n    const redirectUrl = new URL(redirectTo, origin);\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = redirectUrl.pathname;\n    url.search = redirectUrl.search;\n    url.hash = redirectUrl.hash;\n\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  } else {\n    // User needs to verify email, preserve next parameter\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-email\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    if (validatedNext) {\n      // Properly encode the next parameter\n      url.searchParams.set(\"next\", validatedNext);\n    }\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import { ThemeSwitcher } from \"@/components/theme-switcher\";\nimport { DeveloperLinks } from \"@/components/developer-links\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\nexport default async function Home() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n  const isLoggedIn = !!user;\n\n  return (\n    &lt;main className=\"min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-background\"&gt;\n      {/* Header with theme toggle */}\n      &lt;header className=\"absolute top-0 right-0 p-4\"&gt;\n        &lt;ThemeSwitcher /&gt;\n      &lt;/header&gt;\n\n      {/* Main content */}\n      &lt;div className=\"flex-1 flex items-center justify-center p-4\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-md space-y-8\"&gt;\n          {/* Tappka Logo/Branding */}\n          &lt;div className=\"text-center space-y-3\"&gt;\n            &lt;h1 className=\"text-5xl font-heading font-bold text-primary tracking-tight\"&gt;\n              Tappka\n            &lt;/h1&gt;\n            &lt;p className=\"text-muted-foreground text-sm\"&gt;\n              Pro Téčka a kouče Tiimiakatemia Prague\n            &lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n\n          {/* Conditional content based on login status */}\n          {isLoggedIn ?         "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  // Allow public routes without authentication\n  if (isPublicRoute(pathname)) {\n    // Handle authenticated users visiting login page - redirect them\n    if (pathname === \"/auth/login\") {\n      // Use getUser() instead of getClaims() to validate the user actually exists\n      // getClaims() can return truthy values even with invalid/deleted users\n      const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n      // Only redirect if we have a valid user (not just claims)\n      // This prevents infinite redirect loops when token is invalid but claims exist\n      if (!error &amp;&amp; user) {\n        // Get next parameter from query string\n        const next = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n        // Validate next parameter to prevent open redirects\n        const origin = request.nextUrl.origin;\n        const validatedNext = next ? validateRedirectUrl(next, origin) : null;\n        const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n\n        const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n        url.pathname = redirectTo;\n        url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n        url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n        return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n      }\n    }\n    return supabaseResponse;\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!user) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n  const { data: getUserData, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n  const authUser = getUserData?.user;\n\n  if (error) {\n    console.error(\"supabase.auth.getUser error\", error);\n  }\n\n  if (!authUser) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n}",

        "contents": "export default async function QuickStatusPage({ params }: QuickPageProps) {\n\n  let currentReservationData = undefined;\n  let alternativeRooms = undefined;\n\n  if (currentReservation) {\n    const endTime = new Date(currentReservation.end_time);\n    const endsInMinutes = Math.round((endTime.getTime() - now.getTime()) / (1000 * 60));\n\n    const occupantName = currentReservation.user?.full_name ||\n      currentReservation.team?.name ||\n      \"Neznámý\";\n\n    currentReservationData = {\n      title: currentReservation.title,\n      occupantName,\n      personCount: currentReservation.person_count,\n      startTime: currentReservation.start_time,\n      endTime: currentReservation.end_time,\n      endsInMinutes,\n    };\n\n    // Fetch alternative rooms that are currently free\n    const { data: allRooms } = await supabase\n      .from(\"rooms\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .neq(\"id\", room.id)\n      .order(\"code\");\n\n    if (allRooms &amp;&amp; allRooms.length &gt; 0) {\n      // Check which rooms are free\n      const { data: otherCurrentReservations } = await supabase\n        .from(\"reservations\")\n        .select(\"room_id\")\n        .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n        .lte(\"start_time\", nowIso)\n        .gt(\"end_time\", nowIso);\n\n      const occupiedRoomIds = new Set(\n        (otherCurrentReservations || []).map((r) =&gt; r.room_id)\n      );\n\n      const freeRooms = allRooms.filter((r) =&gt; !occupiedRoomIds.has(r.id));\n\n      // Sort by relevance\n      const sortedFreeRooms = sortAlternativeRooms(freeRooms, room);\n\n      // Take top 3\n      alternativeRooms = sortedFreeRooms.slice(0, 3).map((r) =&gt; ({\n        id: r.id,\n        code: r.code,\n        name: r.name,\n      }));\n    }\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;RoomQuickStatus\n      {...quickStatusData}\n      currentReservation={currentReservationData}\n      alternativeRooms={alternativeRooms}\n    /&gt;\n  );\n}",

Fixed: the login page wasn't reading the `next` query parameter from the URL.

**What I changed:**
1. Added a `LoginPageProps` interface that accepts `searchParams` as a Promise (Next.js App Router pattern)
2. Extracted the `next` parameter from `searchParams`
3. Passed `next` to the `LoginForm` component

The flow now works:
- `/auth/login?next=asda` → page reads `next`
- `LoginForm` receives `next` → passes it to `GoogleLoginButton`
- `GoogleLoginButton` includes `next` in the OAuth callback URL
- After authentication, the user is redirected to the `next` URL

The `next` parameter is now passed through the entire authentication flow.

{\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n  if (error) {\n    return redirectWithCookies(createErrorUrl(request, error.message), supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has email identity linked\n  // If not, redirect to verify-email page\n  // Use the same supabase client to ensure we have the just-exchanged session\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n\n  // Validate the next parameter to prevent open redirects\n  const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, origin);\n\n  if (hasEmail) {\n    // User has email identity, redirect to next or default page\n    const redirectTo = validatedNext ??         "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { isPublicRoute, DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity, hasLinkedProfile, redirectWithCookies } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\n\n/**\n * Safely executes an async check function, catching any errors\n * and treating them as a failed check to preserve graceful redirect behavior\n * @param checkFn - The async function to execute\n * @param checkName - Name of the check for logging purposes\n * @returns Object with ok boolean and optional error\n */\nasync function safeCheck(\n  checkFn: () =&gt; Promise&lt;boolean&gt;,\n  checkName: string,\n): Promise&lt;{ ok: boolean; error?: Error }&gt; {\n  try {\n    const result = await checkFn();\n    return { ok: result };\n  } catch (error) {\n    const err = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));\n    console.error(&#96;Error in ${checkName}:&#96;, err);\n    return { ok: false, error: err };\n  }\n}\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n}",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  // Allow public routes without authentication\n  if (isPublicRoute(pathname)) {\n    // Handle authenticated users visiting login page - redirect them\n    if (pathname === \"/auth/login\") {\n      // Use getUser() instead of getClaims() to validate the user actually exists\n      // getClaims() can return truthy values even with invalid/deleted users\n      const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n      // Only redirect if we have a valid user (not just claims)\n      // This prevents infinite redirect loops when token is invalid but claims exist\n      if (!error &amp;&amp; user) {\n        // Get next parameter from query string\n        const next = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n        // Validate next parameter to prevent open redirects\n        const origin = request.nextUrl.origin;\n        const validatedNext = next ? validateRedirectUrl(next, origin) : null;\n        const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n\n        const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n        url.pathname = redirectTo;\n        url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n        url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n        return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n      }\n    }\n    return supabaseResponse;\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!user) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n  const { data: getUserData, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n  const authUser = getUserData?.user;\n\n  if (error) {\n    console.error(\"supabase.auth.getUser error\", error);\n  }\n\n  if (!authUser) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n}",

        },
        "contents": "/**\n * Validates that a redirect URL is safe (same-origin or relative path)\n * Prevents open redirect vulnerabilities by rejecting external URLs\n * @param url - The URL to validate (can be relative path or absolute URL)\n * @param origin - The origin of the current request\n * @returns The validated safe path, or null if validation fails\n */\nexport function validateRedirectUrl(url: string | null, origin: string): string | null {\n  if (!url) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Reject empty strings\n  if (url.trim() === \"\") {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Allow relative paths (starting with /)\n  if (url.startsWith(\"/\")) {\n    // Ensure it doesn't contain protocol-relative URLs or other schemes\n    if (url.includes(\"://\") || url.startsWith(\"//\") || url.startsWith(\"javascript:\")) {\n      return null;\n    }\n    return url;\n  }\n\n  // For absolute URLs, check if they're same-origin\n  try {\n    const urlObj = new URL(url, origin);\n    const originObj = new URL(origin);\n\n    // Reject if protocol doesn't match (http vs https)\n    if (urlObj.protocol !== originObj.protocol) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // Reject if host doesn't match\n    if (urlObj.host !== originObj.host) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // Return the pathname + search + hash (same-origin URL is safe)\n    return urlObj.pathname + urlObj.search + urlObj.hash;\n  } catch {\n    // Invalid URL format\n    return null;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * GET /r/[code]\n * Short URL redirect for QR codes\n * - If user is logged in -&gt; reservations/[code]/qr\n * - If not logged in -&gt; /rezervace/[code]\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest, { params }: RouteParams) {\n  const { code } = await params;\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Check if user is logged in\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (user) {\n    // Logged in -&gt; redirect to quick status page\n    const url = new URL(&#96;/reservations/${code}/quick&#96;, request.url);\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  } else {\n    // Not logged in -&gt; redirect to public page\n    const url = new URL(&#96;/rezervace/${code}&#96;, request.url);\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n}",

          }
        },
        "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { createServerClient } from \"@supabase/ssr\";\nimport {\n  createErrorUrl,\n  createSuccessUrl,\n  redirectWithCookies,\n} from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * Handles email change confirmation callback using PKCE flow with token_hash\n * Verifies the OTP token and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const typeParam = searchParams.get(\"type\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n  const type: EmailOtpType | null =\n    typeParam === \"email_change\" ? (\"email_change\" as EmailOtpType) : null;\n\n  if (!type) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"Invalid type\"));\n  }\n  if (!token_hash) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"Invalid token hash\"));\n  }\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt; {\n            request.cookies.set(name, value);\n          });\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n    type,\n    token_hash,\n  });\n  if (error) {\n    return redirectWithCookies(createErrorUrl(request, error.message), supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  return redirectWithCookies(createSuccessUrl(request, next), supabaseResponse);\n}",

        "contents": "export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  if (hasEmail) {\n    // User has email identity, redirect to next or default page\n    const redirectTo = validatedNext ??         "contents": "/**\n * Creates a success redirect URL\n * @param request - The NextRequest object\n * @param next - Optional next parameter to redirect to after success\n * @returns URL object for redirect\n */\nexport function createSuccessUrl(request: NextRequest, next?: string | null): URL {\n  const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n\n  if (next) {\n    // Validate next parameter to prevent open redirects\n    const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, request.nextUrl.origin);\n    if (validatedNext) {\n      // Parse the redirect URL to handle query parameters and hash properly\n      const redirectUrl = new URL(validatedNext, request.nextUrl.origin);\n      url.pathname = redirectUrl.pathname;\n      url.search = redirectUrl.search;\n      url.hash = redirectUrl.hash;\n      return url;\n    }\n  }\n\n  url.pathname = DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n  url.search = \"\"; // Clear any existing search params\n  url.hash = \"\"; // Clear any existing hash\n  return url;\n}\n\n/**\n * Creates a redirect response with cookies copied from supabaseResponse\n * Preserves all cookie options (httpOnly, secure, sameSite, etc.)\n */",

        "contents": "import { ThemeSwitcher } from \"@/components/theme-switcher\";\nimport { LogoutButton } from \"@/components/logout-button\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\n\nexport default async function VerifyPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const {\n    data: { user },\n  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  // Must be logged in to access verification\n  if (!user) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Check if already verified\n  const { data: profile } = await supabase\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\"is_verified, full_name\")\n    .eq(\"id\", user.id)\n    .single();\n\n  if (profile?.is_verified) {\n    redirect(\"/\");\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;main className=\"min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-background\"&gt;\n      {/* Header */}\n      &lt;header className=\"flex justify-between items-center p-4\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"text-sm text-muted-foreground\"&gt;\n          &lt;span className=\"font-medium text-foreground\"&gt;{profile?.full_name || user.email}&lt;/span&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"flex gap-2\"&gt;\n          &lt;ThemeSwitcher /&gt;\n          &lt;LogoutButton /&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/header&gt;\n\n      {/* Main content */}\n      &lt;div className=\"flex-1 flex items-center justify-center p-4\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-md space-y-8\"&gt;\n          {/* Tappka Logo/Branding */}\n          &lt;div className=\"text-center space-y-3\"&gt;\n            &lt;h1 className=\"text-5xl font-heading font-bold text-primary tracking-tight\"&gt;\n              Tappka\n            &lt;/h1&gt;\n            &lt;p className=\"text-muted-foreground text-sm\"&gt;\n              Ještě jeden krok k přístupu\n            &lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n\n          {/* Verify Form */}\n          &lt;VerifyForm /&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n\n      {/* Footer */}\n      &lt;footer className=\"p-4 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground\"&gt;\n        &lt;p&gt;Tiimiakatemia         "contents": "/**\n * Room detail page with calendar and reservation form\n */\nexport default async function RoomDetailPage({ params }: RoomDetailPageProps) {\n  const { code } = await params;\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Get current user\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  // Fetch room by code\n  const { data: room, error: roomError } = await supabase\n    .from(\"rooms\")\n    .select(\"*\")\n    .eq(\"code\", code.toLowerCase())\n    .single();\n\n  if (roomError || !room) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  // Fetch data in parallel\n  // Include past 7 days for navigation + future 14 days\n  const today = new Date();\n  today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);\n\n  const oneWeekAgo = new Date(today);\n  oneWeekAgo.setDate(oneWeekAgo.getDate() - 7);\n\n  const twoWeeksLater = new Date(today);\n  twoWeeksLater.setDate(twoWeeksLater.getDate() + 14);\n\n  const oneWeekAgoStr = oneWeekAgo.toISOString().split(\"T\")[0];\n  const twoWeeksLaterStr = twoWeeksLater.toISOString().split(\"T\")[0];\n\n  const [reservationsResult, issuesResult, alternativeRoomsResult, breaksResult] = await \n;\n}",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  if (!authUser) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // If no email identity, redirect to verify email page\n  // Treat errors as \"no identity\" to preserve graceful redirect behavior\n  const emailIdentityCheck = await safeCheck(\n    () =&gt; hasEmailIdentity(supabase),\n    \"hasEmailIdentity\",\n  );\n  if (!emailIdentityCheck.ok) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-email\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check for linked profile if user is authenticated and not on public routes\n  // Skip this check for verify-email and pending-approval routes\n  // Treat errors as \"no profile\" to preserve graceful redirect behavior\n  const linkedProfileCheck = await safeCheck(\n    () =&gt; hasLinkedProfile(supabase),\n    \"hasLinkedProfile\",\n  );\n  if (!linkedProfileCheck.ok) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/pending-approval\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Strip all query parameters (e.g., from email verification or QR code)\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Strip hash as well\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // For protected routes (dashboard, etc.), we need to check verification\n  // This is done on the page level for better UX with proper error messages\n\n  return supabaseResponse;\n}",

      "codeBlock": {

        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},

            "line": 80,

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\n\n/**\n * Google OAuth login button component\n * Handles both sign-in and sign-up flows seamlessly\n * Validates next parameter to prevent open redirects\n */\nexport function GoogleLoginButton({ next }: { next?: string }) {\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleGoogleLogin = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    const supabase = createClient();\n\n    try {\n      const callbackUrl = new URL(&#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/callback&#96;);\n      if (next) {\n        // Validate next parameter to prevent open redirects (defense-in-depth)\n        const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, window.location.origin);\n        if (validatedNext) {\n          // Properly encode the next parameter - it may contain query parameters itself\n          callbackUrl.searchParams.set(\"next\", validatedNext);\n        }\n      }\n\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n        provider: \"google\",\n        options: {\n          redirectTo: callbackUrl.toString(),\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (error) {\n        console.error(\"Google OAuth error:\", error);\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n      // Note: User will be redirected to Google, so we don't reset loading state here\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Unexpected error:\", error);\n;\n}",

        "contents": "import { createAdminClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/admin\";\nimport { NextRequest, NextResponse } from \"next/server\";\nimport { addMonths, getDay, setHours, setMinutes, startOfMonth, addDays } from \"date-fns\";\nimport type { SupabaseClient } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\n\n/**\n * Helper function to find first Wednesday of a month\n */\nfunction getFirstWednesday(date: Date): Date {\n  const firstDayOfMonth = startOfMonth(date);\n  let firstWednesday = firstDayOfMonth;\n  while (getDay(firstWednesday) !== 3) {\n    firstWednesday = addDays(firstWednesday, 1);\n  }\n  return firstWednesday;\n}\n\n/**\n * Helper function to create HC reservation if it doesn't exist\n * Uses admin client to bypass RLS for system operations\n */",

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "import { createAdminClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/admin\";",

        "contents": "import { ThemeSwitcher } from \"@/components/theme-switcher\";\nimport { DeveloperLinks } from \"@/components/developer-links\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\nimport { headers } from \"next/headers\";\n\ninterface LoginPageProps {\n  searchParams: Promise&lt;{ next?: string }&gt;;\n}\n\nexport default async function Home({ searchParams }: LoginPageProps) {\n  const { next } = await searchParams;\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n  const isLoggedIn = !!user;\n\n  // Validate next parameter to prevent open redirects\n  const headersList = await headers();\n  const origin = headersList.get(\"host\")\n    ? &#96;${headersList.get(\"x-forwarded-proto\") || \"http\"}://${headersList.get(\"host\")}&#96;\n    : \"http://localhost:3000\";\n  const validatedNext = next ? validateRedirectUrl(next, origin) : undefined;\n\n  return (\n    &lt;main className=\"min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-background\"&gt;\n      {/* Header with theme toggle */}\n      &lt;header className=\"absolute top-0 right-0 p-4\"&gt;\n        &lt;ThemeSwitcher /&gt;\n      &lt;/header&gt;\n\n      {/* Main content */}\n      &lt;div className=\"flex-1 flex items-center justify-center p-4\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-md space-y-8\"&gt;\n          {/* Tappka Logo/Branding */}\n          &lt;div className=\"text-center space-y-3\"&gt;\n            &lt;h1 className=\"text-5xl font-heading font-bold text-primary tracking-tight\"&gt;\n              Tappka\n            &lt;/h1&gt;\n            &lt;p className=\"text-muted-foreground text-sm\"&gt;\n              Pro Téčka a kouče Tiimiakatemia Prague\n            &lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n\n          {/* Conditional content based on login status */}\n          {isLoggedIn ? (\n            &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-4\"&gt;\n              &lt;Button asChild className=\"w-full\" size=\"lg\"&gt;\n                &lt;Link href={DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE}&gt;\n                  přejít do Tappky\n                &lt;/Link&gt;\n              &lt;/Button&gt;\n            &lt;/div&gt;\n          ) : (\n            &lt;LoginForm next={validatedNext} /&gt;\n          )}\n\n          {/* Developer Tools */}\n          &lt;DeveloperLinks /&gt;\n}",
